model.architecture: Qwen3.5 hybrid (Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration text decoder: 18 GatedDeltaNet linear-attention + 6 gated full-attention layers) with a verify signature and the checkpoint's own 1-layer MTP head as the LiteRT-LM drafter section

variants.quantization: dynamic int8 (linears + embedding tables) on the base graph, the externalized embedder and the drafter; convs and the delta rule stay float

platform_notes: Requires litert-lm >= 0.16.0; speculative decoding is opt-in (CLI --speculative-decoding true, python enable_speculative_decoding=True)
Bug-repro artifact for LiteRT-LM #3439, not a release; CPU only (GPU not gated with the drafter section)
Flag off, the bundle behaves as a plain Qwen3.5-0.8B int8 conversion with a simple ChatML template (thinking disabled)

measured.source: litertlm-convert mtp_work/e2e_08b.json (bench.on); engine acceptance 0.476-0.710 per prompt, mean 2.76 tokens/round

known_issues: Under --speculative-decoding true the runtime never commits the turn-final stop token (LiteRT-LM #3439): multi-turn transcripts lose <|im_end|> after every assistant turn and this 0.8B degrades on later turns; single-turn use unaffected. Reproduces on litert-lm 0.16.0 and 0.16.1.
